column1: # tick_pair_map.tsv -- which vendored tick corresponds to which executing feed.
# WHY THIS IS DECLARED AND NOT INFERRED.
# The two naming schemes do not line up, and a gate that guesses compares two
# unrelated files and then reports "no drift" with total confidence:
# Strip "-bundle" and email breaks. Keep it and the other three break. There is
# no rule, so there is a table.
# ESTABLISHED EMPIRICALLY, not by reading the names. difflib line-ratio of each
# vendored file against all ten executing feeds, 2026-08-14:
# iMessage's ratio is the outlier and that is NOT a weak pairing -- it is the
# drift itself showing up in the number. 222 lines sealed against 299 vendored,
# because the vendored copy carries the FDA preflight the executing one lacks.
# The margin over its runner-up is still the widest thing available. Re-measure
# UNPAIRED IS A STEADY STATE, NOT A DEFECT. Six executing feeds have no CM051
# counterpart because CM051 vendors four sources and the daemon runs ten. The
# gate COUNTS and PRINTS them and does not fail on them -- but it must never
# silently drop them, because "no counterpart" and "counterpart missing" print
# identically if you are not looking.
